question: How does touching an afflicted person while meditating and repeating the mantra heal him?
premises: One meditates and repeats the mantra.
One touches the afflicted person with both hands.
The afflicted person becomes happy and well.
inference: Meditating, repeating the mantra, and touching the afflicted person with both hands makes him well.
plain_english: Having meditated and while repeating the mantra, one should touch the afflicted person with both hands; he may become well.
